purpose: Reconcile the complete development plan, progress and follow-up work.
method: Cross-check all 72 requirement texts and statuses against current generated design/catalog, archived acceptance, selected live source inspection and final CI. Not an exhaustive per-function code review or fresh runtime/content/human acceptance.
completionPercentageReason: Requirement statuses, feature counts and test counts are not a product completion rate.
milestones: M0 durable original repair, final long-PDF acceptance and deployment
M1 complete classroom and reference-state parity
M2 course lifecycle, input controls and content workflow
M3 atomic assessment, falsifiable diagnosis and guidance
M4 complete textbook and GESP curriculum coverage
M5 paper workflows and full asset reconciliation
M6 AI, inspectable memory and calendar continuity
M7 real devices, real spaced learning and final handoff
excluded: bidirectional school grades and homework writeback
